# Bingo Reloaded 3.6

This update includes a ton of bug fixes for 3.6, allowing me to drop the beta name.
For completion's sake, there are all the changes made in 3.6.0.

This update of the plugin is intended for Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3.

## New Features
- ## Updated to support Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3 only.
- ## Added new custom items
  - Can be obtained to make custom kits with using `/bingo kit item`
  - Now there is more to choose besides the Go-Up-Wand:
    - *Team Teleporter*: Teleport to your fellow team mates or to the spawn platform location.
    - *Neverending Pearl*: An enderpearl with infinite uses.
    - *Team Pouch*: A shared inventory between your team. (quickly share items with your team.)
  - All new items have options to change behavior in `config.yml` (mostly cooldowns)
- ## Added new effects
  - Effects can be chosen in the main bingo settings menu.
    - *Vein Miner*: Mine lots of blocks in one go! vein-minable blocks can be configured inside `veinminer_settings.yml`
    - *Item Magnet*: Item drops are picked up instantly instead of dropping in the world.
  - Both new effects can be combined for a new fast-paced playstyle.
- ## Added teleport strategy **GRID** to make it possible to play on a pre-genned world.
  - Added a bunch of parameters in `config.yml` to set up the grid.
  - Allows random teleportation but without repetition of starting locations.
- ## Added List editor to companion mod
  - Added a new way to edit card lists to make the management of tasks on a list easier.
  - The companion mod is required for this feature.
  - Like the normal card creator, this feature can only be used by players with the `bingo.admin` permission.
  - Added an option to the config screen in companion to enable/disable the new editor.
  - Expect more updates on the card creator in upcoming updates.
- ### Added support for custom advancements
  - You can now install (or make!) advancement datapacks and properly use the advancements in the card creator.
- ### Added formatting options for the task names
  - Configurable inside `task_formatting.yml`
  - Can be configured separately for different task types and sub-types (in the case of statistics).
- ### Added dye color selection to the team edit menu.
  - Some items (currently just the team pouch) can be colored with a dye color automatically, based on the team.
  - Configurable in the team editor menu (using `/bingo teamedit`)
  
## Changed Features
- ### Changed the scaling of damage related statistic tasks to make more sense.
  - The count on the task now represents the amount of damage in player hearts.
- ### Improved order of usable items.
  - When holding a custom item in each hand, the game will now try to perform the main hand's action first and only if it fails try the off-hand. This results in fewer accidental card menu opens if you are holding the card in your off-hand.
- ### Changed the card creator to allow the card name to have upper case letters and spaces.
- ### The game now clears your inventory right before teleporting you to the lobby.
  - No souvenirs for the lobby! You do get to keep the card, but only until the game resets.

## Bug fixes
- ### Fixed teleport back to death message from showing up even when the config option is disabled.
- ### Fixed a bug where card descriptions sometimes were not shown in menus.
- ### Fixed a bug where deathmatch always chooses the same item.
- ### Fixed a bug where the players would not get respawned at the lobby after the game has ended.
- ### Fixed a bug where the players would not get respawned at the lobby after rejoining the server during or after a game.
- ### Fixed a bug where the card description editor did not show up when creating a new card.

## Notes
- No additional notes, other than the fact that epic updates are on the way!

## Discord
Contact me in my [discord server](https://discord.gg/AzZNxPRNPf) for any requests or changes as that's where I hang out more often compared to over here.

# Bingo Reloaded 3.5.2

Another round of bug fixes and small improvements across the whole plugin.

## New Features
- ### Added `bingo.host` permission.
  - hosts have the permission to change settings in the menu and start/stop a game, using the Settings item, or the `/bingo` command.
  - permissions can be assigned to players using a plugin such as luckperms.
- ### Added a toggle button in the task list editor to show only the added tasks instead of every single task.
  
## Changed Features
- ### Moved application of grace period effect to after the game started.
  - before this grace period was applied before the starting timer was finished.
  - An extra grace period effect is now given instead at that time, but is not configurable and ends when the starting timer ends. At this point the normal grace period time starts.
- ### Switched some button icons around to be more consistent in the GUI.
  - mainly regarding the card and task lists.
    - Lists are represented as Books
    - Cards are represented as Flower Charge Banner Patterns.
- ### Tags are now set on the card itself using the card creator instead of in the settings menu.
  - This will make it easier to pick the correct card you want and allow you to present clear choices to players voting for cards. 
  - Right click in the card selector to edit the card's excluded tags, among other things.
- ### Delayed the `sendCommandBeforeGameStarts` commands to right after the point of teleportation.
  - This will allow admins to set up commands to do things like give specific player effects for the starting cooldown, e.g. blindness.
  - However, player effects specifically will still get replaced with the effects selected in the settings menu after the starting timer is done.

## Bug fixes
- ### Fixed a bug that ignored task tags for hotswap and blitz when creating new tasks to complete.
- ### Fixed a bug that prevented players from using the previous page and next page buttons on certain GUI menus like the team selection menu.
- ### Fixed a bug that prevented deathmatch from starting, instead ending the game on a tie.
  - Now the deathmatch properly starts again on eligable gamemodes.

## Discord
Contact me in my [discord server](https://discord.gg/AzZNxPRNPf) for any requests or changes as that's where I hang out more often compared to over here.

# Bingo Reloaded 3.5.1

Blitz is broken, this update is here to fix it.

## New Features
- ### Add config option to disable team prefix in tab and player name tag.
  - This option is simply called `disableTeamPrefix` and can be used when you have other plugins changing player names in a conflicting way.

## Changed Features
- ### All the `sendCommand...` config options now accept multiple commands.
  - For now this can only be edited in the config file directly, with limited support using the bingoconfig command.

## Bug fixes
- ### Fixed an error in the console that occurs when you complete a task at the same time as a task gets recovered in Blitz.
- ### Fixed an error that sometimes appeared when using the `/bingo view` command.
- ### Fixed a bug where the game would end if a teammate left the world in Blitz.

- ### Be on the lookout for more unique Custom Items like the Go-Up-Wand in the next update, as well as changes to organizing games in both Configuration SINGULAR and MULTIPLE!

# Bingo Reloaded 3.5

Time for another update, don't you think?

Most notable additions:
  - Support for 26.1.2
  - New gamemode: Blitz
  - Bingo Leaderboard: "What's your record game completion time?"

This version is also available for 1.21.11, but any future releases (except bug fixes) will only be made for 26.1 and up!

Bingo Reloaded Companion has been updated to 1.4 to support blitz and the new minecraft version.

So what else has been added? Read the full changelog below.

## New Features
- ## Add support for minecraft 26.1.2
  - No changes made to the default card, but my recommendation for custom cards is to add a golden dandelion (or a statistic task to use the dandelion on an animal), its a decent challenge!
- ## New Gamemode: Blitz!
  - Unique gamemode only playable by a single team.
  - The game starts with a very small amount of time, when you complete a task, you get bonus time. The goal is to complete as many tasks as possible before time runs out.
  - When choosing this gamemode, you have the following additional options, which can be tweaked to make it easier or harder to achieve a higher score:
    - Starting duration: The amount of time you get at the start of the game.
    - Bonus duration: The amount of time you gain by completing a task.
    - Recovery delay: The amount of items you have to complete before a completed item gets regenerated (like Hot-Swap).
- ## Leaderboard
  - Can be accessed by everyone using `/bingo leaderboard`.
  - Shows a list of games completed in the future and which team got the most points or lowest time, depending on the gamemode.
  - Configurable in the config, adding a `leaderboard` section:
    - `leaderboard.enable`: if not enabled, will not record games and the menu cannot be shown using the command.
    - `leaderboard.saveCancelledGames`: If enabled, will also record the games that have been cancelled or otherwise not been completed.
    - `leaderboard.onlyUsePresetCategories`: By default, the leaderboard creates categories based on the chosen settings (gamemode, kit, etc). With this setting, categories will only be created for saved settings presets. In this case, any games not played with a settings preset (or comparable settings), will not show up on the leaderboard.
  - If `savePlayerStatistics` is enabled, the leaderboard screen allows you to view your own statistics regarding your amount of wins, losses, item uses and more.

- ### New config options
  - `disableNether`, `disableTheEnd`: setting these to true allows you to play in a server that has no nether and/or end dimension. in Configuration: MULTIPLE, no nether and/or end level will be created in that case.
  - `sendCommandAfterGameEndsPerPlayer`: called for a player when the game is finished. The placeholder *{player}* can be used to let the plugin fill in the name of the player when the command gets called. has 3 subcommands:
    - `everyPlayer`: Sends this command for every player in the game, including spectators.
    - `winningPlayers`: Send this command for every player that was on the winning team, e.g. can be used to add points to the player's balance.
    - `losingPlayers`: Send this command for every player that was not on the winning team.
    - `disableCardMenuFromItem`: When this option is set to true, the card item will not pop up the bingo menu when right clicked. Instead, `/bingo view` has to be used to see the card in detail.

- ### Added tags to the card creator
  - Tasks can be tagged with tags, both custom and preset tags. This allows you to select a card in the `/bingo` menu that exclude tasks tagged with certain tags. 
  - Preset tags added by the plugin:
    - `<nether>`: Tasks only completable in the nether can be tagged with this tag. When `disableNether` is used, these tasks will be omitted automatically.
    - `<the_end>`: Tasks only completable in the end can be tagged with this tag. When `disableThEnd` is used, these tasks will be omitted automatically.

# Bingo Reloaded 3.0

Time for a big update!

More specifically, this update removes spigot support is favor of Paper's improved API.
Furthermore, this version of the plugin will only support 1.21.1 and newer versions.

Let's get into the changes

## New Features
- ### Exclusive Paper support!
  - This plugin now fully runs on the Paper API, meaning you need a paper server to use this plugin.
  - This comes with additional changes, listed below.
- ### Added Minimessage support
  - Converted existing translations, placeholder formats and scoreboards to use new minimessage strings, removing old custom formatting.
  - Click [here](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html) to learn more about minimessage.
  - The tag `<tiny:'Some Text'>` can be used to convert "Some Text" to tiny caps.
  - The tag {$path} for translations has been changed to `<bingo_translate:'path'>`.
  - Arguments are still written as {0}, but \<0> is also valid.
- ### Additional settings for gamemodes Complete-X and Hot-Swap
  - Complete-all has been renamed to Complete-X, by default this gamemode will play the exact same way as Complete-all did.
  - Added win goal setting to complete-x. Use this to configure how many tasks need to be completed to win, by default this is the full card.
  - Added Hot-Swap expire Tasks setting. This setting makes the time based expiration of tasks during Hot-Swap optional.
- ### New Autobingo commands
  - `/autobingo <world_name> playerdata <save | load | remove> <player_name>` - Command created to manage player data manually. Can be used even when config.savePlayerInformation is set to false, to completely ignore the existing saving strategy.
  - `/autobingo <world_name> kickplayers <target_world>` - use to kick all players of a world to the target world
  - `/autobingo <world_name> hotswap_goal <goal>` - configure new hotswap goal setting
  - `/autobingo <world_name> hotswap_expire <true | false>` - configure new hotswap expire setting
  - `/autobingo <world_name> complete-goal <goal>` - configure new complete goal setting
  - For a list of all autobingo commands, [click here](https://github.com/Steaf23/BingoReloaded/wiki/Autobingo-Command)
- ### New placeholders
  - `%bingoreloaded_created_session_<world_name>` - returns empty string if the world has not been created, and the world name if it has.
  - `%bingoreloaded_hotswap_winscore%` - Returns the score set to win hot-swap.
  - `%bingoreloaded_hotswap_expire%` - Returns whether hotswap tasks will expire on their own or not.
  - `%bingoreloaded_complete_winscore%` - Returns the score set to win complete-x.
- ### Added `enableDebugLogging` config option
  - Debug logging is used for when things went wrong and we need to find out why it went wrong. Not very important for the average user.
  - Turned off by default.
  - Better ways to manage the debug log file will be added in the future.
- ### Added Russian translation
  - added russian translation file "ru.yml" to the available languages for bingo

## Changed Features
- ### New configuration files
  - Switched all data configuration files from yaml to nbt data, reducing their file size substantially. This means it's not easily editable by hand anymore, which is the point. All these files now have dedicated methods to edit them in-game.
  - Added automatic conversion between old and new files, so even if you have created 10 custom lists, this conversion will be fully automatic and lossless.
  - If you want to edit these files manually still, it is possible using any NBT editor, but discouraged if you don't know what you are doing.
  - The old yaml files will stay on the server, so if you experience any issues converting data automatically, please seek support on the discord server.
- ### Countdown mode
  - Changed the Countdown option (previously either enabled or disabled), to have more options.
  - Pick between:
    - *DISABLED*: No countdown timer is used.

2 updates for the price of one, because I messed up :P

Here is a small update, fixing some critical issues and adding an exciting feature for me (I promise the next update adds exciting features for everyone :D)

## === 2.1.2 ===

## Bug fixes
- ### Fixed spawning locations for players that used and broke a bed
  - After a player used and breaks a bed spawn, they will now be respawned at the game's spawn point decided at the start of the game.
  - Bed obstruction/destroyed message still appears, to let you know the bed spawn has been broken.
  - Also works for respawn anchors if for some reason you want to use those.

## === 2.1.1 ===

## New Features
- ### Added bStats Metrics. 
    - Maybe not as important to users, but it helps the plugin a ton to know what settings server owners are using for my plugin. This way I can make sure future updates are more tailored to what people are using.
    - Aside from the standard metrics, the chosen language and configuration setting as found in config.yml are being tracked as well.

## Changed Features
- ### PacketEvents dependency is now required separately.
	- Packet Events is used to display the team names properly, so its vital to making the plugin function correctly. This change allows you to update packet events separately if I am unable to update the plugin quickly and there are game-breaking bugs with regards to the packet events version.

## Bug fixes
- ### Fixed bug crashing the plugin when enabling the plugin. 
  - This happened because the plugin tried to clear the worlds in a non existing worlds folder.
  - The plugin creates the folder on its own before trying to reach for it.
